figures.name: Vishnu

ability.name: Sudarshana Chakra
ability.description: Launch the divine discus: deal 7 damage to one enemy ignoring all defense.

figures.description: The supreme preserver of the cosmos who descends as avatars in each age to restore dharmic order.

figures.name: Rama

ability.name: Brahmastra Arrow
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to any target ignoring distance and defense; never misses.

figures.description: The ideal king and Vishnu's seventh avatar whose perfect adherence to dharma defines righteous conduct.

figures.name: Krishna

ability.name: Vishvarupa
ability.description: Reveal ultimate form: all enemies are stunned for 1 turn from cosmic overwhelming.

figures.description: The most beloved of Vishnu's avatars who revealed the Bhagavad Gita and whose playful love encompasses all.

figures.name: Hanuman

ability.name: Devotion's Might
ability.description: Become invincible for 1 turn through absolute devotion; deal 5 damage.

figures.description: Son of Vayu the wind god whose absolute devotion to Rama grants him powers beyond measurement.

figures.name: Lakshmi

ability.name: Lotus Blessing
ability.description: Restore 4 HP to all allies; grant +2 to the lowest stat of every ally.

figures.description: Goddess of wealth, beauty and prosperity who rose from the churning ocean and chose Vishnu as her eternal consort.

figures.name: Garuda

ability.name: Wing Gust
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to all serpent/naga enemies; grant all allies +2 speed.

figures.description: The great eagle king and vehicle of Vishnu who is the eternal enemy of serpents and guardian of the gods.

figures.name: Narasimha

ability.name: Half-Man Half-Lion
ability.description: Destroy one enemy who exploits a technicality; this attack cannot be avoided by any means.

figures.description: The man-lion fourth avatar of Vishnu who slays the demon Hiranyakashipu in a way that fulfills every impossible condition.

figures.name: Prahlada

ability.name: Devotee's Shield
ability.description: Grant one ally complete immunity to dark and fire damage for 2 turns.

figures.description: The child devotee of Vishnu whose absolute faith made him immune to all the tortures his demon father devised.

figures.name: Vamana

ability.name: Three Steps
ability.description: This card expands to cover the entire field for 1 turn; enemy cannot use global abilities.

figures.description: The dwarf Brahmin fifth avatar who grew to cosmic size and claimed all three worlds in three steps.

figures.name: Parashurama

ability.name: Brahmin's Axe
ability.description: Deal 5 damage and reduce all warrior-class enemies' power by 2.

figures.description: The brahmin warrior avatar of Vishnu who cleared the earth of corrupt warrior kings 21 times with his axe.

figures.name: Balarama

ability.name: Divine Plow
ability.description: Drag one enemy from any row to front row; deal 4 damage.

figures.description: Krishna's elder brother wielding plow and mace whose incredible strength equals his divine sibling.

figures.name: Radha

ability.name: Eternal Beloved
ability.description: Grant one ally +4 magic from the power of unconditional divine love.

figures.description: Krishna's supreme beloved whose love for him represents the soul's love for the divine, highest of all devotions.

figures.name: Rukmini

ability.name: Queen's Devotion
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to one ally; grant them immunity to charm and seduction for 1 turn.

figures.description: Krishna's chief queen who eloped with him by her own choice, representing the ideal of active devotion.

figures.name: Sudama

ability.name: Friendship's Grace
ability.description: The ally with the lowest stats on your side gains +5 to all stats from divine friendship.

figures.description: The poor childhood friend of Krishna whose humble offering of rice was rewarded with divine abundance.

figures.name: Draupadi

ability.name: Divine Protection
ability.description: When stripped of protection, this card gains +2 to all stats from righteous outrage.

figures.description: The fire-born wife of the Pandavas whose humiliation triggered the Mahabharata war and who received divine protection.

figures.name: Jatayu

ability.name: Final Flight
ability.description: Sacrifice this card to prevent one enemy from escaping or using a retreat ability.

figures.description: The ancient eagle king who fought Ravana to save Sita and died giving Rama crucial information with his last breath.

figures.name: Vibhishana

ability.name: Righteous Defection
ability.description: Convert one enemy card to your side for 1 turn from the power of dharma.

figures.description: Ravana's younger brother who defected to Rama's side for dharmic reasons and became king of Lanka.

figures.name: Akrura

ability.name: Sacred Messenger
ability.description: Grant one ally foreknowledge of one enemy action this turn.

figures.description: The devoted messenger who brought Krishna to Mathura and received a vision of the cosmic Vishnu in the river.

figures.name: Vishnu's Ananta

ability.name: Cosmic Coil
ability.description: Grant all Vishnu allies +2 defense; this card can share any stat with any ally for 1 turn.

figures.description: The great thousand-headed cosmic serpent Ananta on whom Vishnu sleeps between creations.

figures.name: Matsya

ability.name: Flood Warning
ability.description: Predict one enemy area attack and grant all allies +3 defense against it.

figures.description: The fish first avatar of Vishnu who warned Manu of the great flood and guided his boat to safety.
